baseline.limitations: One fault is injected inside a local Python SDK wrapper, not by the AWS Emulator service or a live network. Real emulator calls persist synthetic S3/DynamoDB/SQS resources. The recovered producer is at-least-once; the single synthetic consumer-effect marker is idempotent, but neither broker exactly-once semantics nor production AWS fidelity, IAM, security or crash atomicity is established.
